industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Ningbo Shimao Energy Co.,Ltd
summary: Ningbo Shimao Energy Co., Ltd. specializes in the generation of industrial steam and electricity. Its operations are diversified across three distinct business segments: Waste Incineration, Cogeneration, and Environmental Management. The Waste Incineration division focuses on municipal garbage disposal. The Cogeneration unit handles the generation and provision of thermal power. Meanwhile, its Environmental Management segment is dedicated to promoting transparency and oversight in environmental protection data and information. Established on December 10, 2003, the company maintains its headquarters in Yuyao, China.
